name: NCL International Logistics Public Company Limited
summary: NCL International Logistics Public Company Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides international freight forwarding, customs broker, inland transportation, multimodal transport operation, and other freight related services. It operates through four segments: Land Transportation, Freight Forwarding, Non-Vessel Operating Common Carrier, and Producing and Distributing Dialysis. The company was founded in 1994 and is based in Bangkok, Thailand.
